item.title: Kema Sakuranomiya Park: Osaka's Great Riverside Cherry Avenue — Guide
item.description: Kema Sakuranomiya Park stretches for several kilometres along both banks of the Okawa river north of central Osaka, and in early April it becomes one of the city’s most spectacular places to see cherry blossom. Nearly five thousand trees form near-continuous tunnels of pink along the water, best appreciated on a slow walk from Sakuranomiya Station toward the old Mint Bureau, whose private cherry avenue opens to the public for a famous week each spring.
